get.description: Every log entry is a version that can be viewed and restored (newest first).
Read-only view of the project as it was after version ``seq``.
Chat messages of a project (Vercel AI UI message format), oldest first.

AddNote.title: AddNote
AddNote.description: Attach a note. Id and timestamp live in the command so that replay is deterministic.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One German sentence; may contain {param} placeholders

category.title: Category
category.description: building: house or shed with foundation, frame and roof

support.title: Support
support.description: floor: stands on z=0; wall: back side (max y) is fixed to a wall

finish.title: Finish
finish.description: Catalog item id of an oil/glaze, or null

AssemblyDesign.title: AssemblyDesign
AssemblyDesign.description:
A complete parametric design of a buildable object.

Coordinates in mm: x = width (right), y = depth (back), z = height (up), floor z = 0.
Numeric fields (size, at, count, quantity, when, deg) take a number or an arithmetic
expression over parameters and the repeat variable, e.g. 'width_mm - 2 * 18' or
'i * (height_mm - 18) / (shelves - 1)'. Allowed: + - * / // % ( ), min, max, round,
floor, ceil, abs, if(cond, a, b), comparisons and and/or/not.

price_source.title: Price Source
price_source.description: estimate = catalog guide price (range), user = price entered by the user

used_share.title: Used Share
used_share.description: Share of the purchased quantity this project uses (e.g. 0.12 of a screw pack); None = all of it

search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: Search text to look the product up at retailers

Callout.title: Callout
Callout.description: Position bubble at (bx, by) with a leader line to the target point (x, y).

ChangeParameterBy.title: ChangeParameterBy
ChangeParameterBy.description: Change a numeric parameter relatively, e.g. ``width_mm`` by +500.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Command log position of this state (changes on every edit)

Component.title: Component
Component.description: A physical part of the construction. ``ifc_type`` eases a later IFC export.

ConstructionResult.title: ConstructionResult
ConstructionResult.description: Everything the engine derives from the inputs.

material_used.description: Cost of what the project actually consumes (opened packs counted pro rata)

user_priced.title: User Priced
user_priced.description: Number of BOM lines priced by the user

pack_id.title: Pack Id
pack_id.description: Construction pack id, 'design' for a free-form design or 'template'

width_mm.title: Width Mm
width_mm.description: Second cut dimension for sheet parts

note.title: Note
note.description: Contour, cutouts, end cuts or tenons

Cutout.title: Cutout
Cutout.description: Hole through a part (window, slot, grip), in the face plane's (u, v) coordinates.

options.title: Options
options.description: Only for kind=choice, e.g. wood species

DesignParam.title: DesignParam
DesignParam.description: A user-adjustable parameter. Lengths are millimetres and should end in ``_mm``.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: Part ids newly mounted in this step (each part in one step); the engine adds parts, screws and hardware per step

Dimension.title: Dimension
Dimension.description: Linear dimension between two points, drawn ``offset`` mm away from the measured line.

HardwareSpec.title: HardwareSpec
HardwareSpec.description: Explicit hardware, e.g. hinges, castors or brackets. Screws are added automatically.

details.title: Details
details.description: Concrete sub-steps in working order (what to buy/cut, which parts, which screws)

JointSpec.title: JointSpec
JointSpec.description:
Carpentry joint between all touching or overlapping instances of two parts.

tenon: ``part`` ends on ``into`` with a tenon and peg. half_lap: both cross and overlap,
each notched by half. notch: ``part`` sits on ``into`` with a seat cut (rafter on plate).

Note.title: Note
Note.description: Free text attached to a project, e.g. an explanation written by the agent.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: Who produced a piece of content (relevant for AI Act Art. 50 labelling).

ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec
ParamSpec.description: UI metadata of an adjustable parameter (packs and designs alike).

material.title: Material
material.description: Catalog item id or made-to-order lumber 'lumber_<species>_<thickness>x<width>' (any species, any section, e.g. 'lumber_douglas_18x96'). May contain {param} placeholders for choice parameters, e.g. 'lumber_{wood}_18x96'.

size.title: Size
size.description: Box: extent along x, y, z in mm

at.title: At
at.description: Box: minimum corner (x, y, z) before rotation

start.title: Start
start.description: Member: centre of the start end (x, y, z)

end.title: End
end.description: Member: centre of the other end

section.title: Section
section.description: Member: thickness × width, if the material does not fix it

facing.title: Facing
facing.description: Member: thickness direction (default horizontal, across the member)

cuts.title: Cuts
cuts.description: Member end cuts: square, level (horizontal), plumb (vertical), corner (both)

when.title: When
when.description: Include the part only if this evaluates truthy

Polygon.title: Polygon
Polygon.description: Filled face of a projected solid. ``tone`` names a material colour, ``shade`` 0..1 its light.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Unit prices in EUR entered by the user, keyed by BOM item id

ProjectInputs.title: ProjectInputs
ProjectInputs.description: The part of the project that commands change.

ProjectModel.title: ProjectModel
ProjectModel.description: Single source of truth of a construction project.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Command log position of this state (changes on every edit)

Region.title: Region
Region.description: German federal states; building regulations differ per state.

Repeat.title: Repeat
Repeat.description: Repeat a part ``count`` times; ``var`` (0-based index) is usable in its expressions.

ReplaceDesign.title: ReplaceDesign
ReplaceDesign.description: Replace the free-form design; keeps valid params and user notes, drops AI explanations.

Rotation.title: Rotation
Rotation.description: Rotation about an axis through the part's ``at`` point (right-hand rule).

RuleRef.title: RuleRef
RuleRef.description: A versioned engineering rule of thumb used by the engine (provenance).

SetParameters.title: SetParameters
SetParameters.description: Set one or more parameters to absolute values (lengths in mm).

SetPrice.title: SetPrice
SetPrice.description: Set the user's own unit price for a BOM item (EUR); ``None`` returns to the guide price.

apex.title: Apex
apex.description: triangle: u of the apex (default centre)

bumps.title: Bumps
bumps.description: cloud: number of bumps on top

Shape.title: Shape
Shape.description:
Outline of a part in its face plane; the engine derives the exact contour.

The face plane is the one perpendicular to the thinnest dimension (members: length × width).
Local coordinates (u, v) in mm start at the minimum corner: u along the first, v along the
second remaining axis in x, y, z order (members: u along the length from ``start``).

Solid.title: Solid
Solid.description:
A placed part for 3D display. Coordinates in mm: x right, y back, z up; ``at`` = min corner.

Plain boxes are described by ``size``, ``at`` and ``rotation``; shaped, cut or angled parts
carry an engine-computed ``mesh`` (then ``size``/``at`` are their bounding box).

SolidMesh.title: SolidMesh
SolidMesh.description: Triangle mesh in world coordinates for parts that are not plain boxes.

bars.title: Bars
bars.description: Cut piece lengths per purchased bar (linear stock)

StockPlan.title: StockPlan
StockPlan.description: How cut pieces are distributed over purchased stock lengths.

material_cost.title: Material Cost
material_cost.description: Material cost range (EUR) of the project after this change

construction.title: Construction
construction.description: Whether the change replaced the construction
